test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 27 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**The given sentence contains a grammatical error. Identify the segment that contains the error.**

Last Saturday evening we go to a party.
solution:
The erroneous segment is "**go to**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the tense of the verb "**go**" is incorrect.
 
• As we are talking about an event in the past, we need to use the past tense of the verb.
 
• We need to use "**went**" in the sentence.
 
• Hence, the correct sentence is **option 1**.

The correct sentence is* Last Saturday evening we went__ to a party*.
